aboutBackgroundP1: I'm Leandro Rodrigues, a Senior Full Stack Developer in Brasília with more than five years of experience building enterprise software. From March 2022 to November 2024 I worked at QW Software on QWControl, a commercial workload automation platform that competes with Control-M. Today I build Java services at Stefanini.
aboutBackgroundP2: At QWControl I led the move from a single codebase to independent modules and plugins, and I built the VMware dashboard, the Rule Flow editor and the integrations with SAP, NetBackup, SQL databases and z/OS. The product belongs to QW Software, so these pages stay at the level of components and flows, and the screenshots show the real interface running on fake data.
aboutBackgroundP3: Outside work I build Aetheris, a native Kubernetes client for the GNOME desktop, in Rust. I use Claude Code and Codex in my workflow.
